sloka: तस्य तद् वचनम् श्रुत्वा काले साधु निरूपितम् ।सुग्रीवः सत्त्व संपन्नः चकार मतिम् उत्तमाम् ॥४-२९-२८॥
transliteration: tasya tad vacanam śrutvā kāle sādhu nirūpitam ।sugrīvaḥ sattva saṁpannaḥ cakāra matim uttamām ॥4-29-28॥

translations.english: O sinless hero therefore issue your command. There are more than a crore of invincible monkeys. Determine now who should do and what and in which place. We are at your service'.
translations.hindi: है अनघ ! करोड़ों दुद्धंप बंदर आपके अधीन हें, सो आप आज्ञा दीजिए कि, कौन कहाँ जाय
